success_patterns: Validate every requested model variant and specification, rejecting near matches unless the task explicitly asks for substitutes.

patch.reasoning: Across multiple trajectories, success depended on distinguishing close variants and checking that every requested attribute matched—for example, RAM kit size, keyboard edition, and graphics-card model. The skill advises validating hits, but does not explicitly warn against treating a similar variant as an exact match.

edits.content: - For exact-product and requirements tasks, treat model modifiers and specified attributes as meaningful: verify each against the title or product details, and reject near variants (for example, EVO vs. non-EVO or a different capacity/speed). Consider alternatives only when the task asks for substitutes.
